Shortcut-connected Expert Parallelism for Accelerating Mixture of Experts 用于加速混合专家模型的捷径连接专家并行 中英对照版

Weilin Cai、Juyong Jiang、Le Qin、Junwei Cui、Sunghun Kim、Jiayi Huang
The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (Guangzhou)；通讯作者：hjy@hkust-gz.edu.cn

选中正文可高亮 · 高亮写入 Notion

Abstract摘要

Expert parallelism has emerged as a key strategy for distributing the computational workload of sparsely-gated mixture-of-experts (MoE) models across multiple devices, enabling the processing of increasingly large-scale models. However, the All-to-All communication inherent to expert parallelism poses a significant bottleneck, limiting the efficiency of MoE models. Although existing optimization methods partially mitigate this issue, they remain constrained by the sequential dependency between communication and computation operations. To address this challenge, we propose ScMoE, a novel shortcut-connected MoE architecture integrated with an overlapping parallelization strategy. ScMoE decouples communication from its conventional sequential ordering, enabling up to 100% overlap with computation. Compared to the prevalent top-2 MoE baseline, ScMoE achieves speedups of 1.49× in training and 1.82× in inference. Moreover, our experiments and analyses indicate that ScMoE not only achieves comparable but in some instances surpasses the model quality of existing approaches.

专家并行（Expert Parallelism, EP）已成为把稀疏门控混合专家（Mixture of Experts, MoE）模型的计算负载分摊到多台设备上的关键策略，使处理规模不断增大的模型成为可能。然而，专家并行固有的 All-to-All 通信构成显著瓶颈，限制了 MoE 模型的效率。现有优化方法虽能部分缓解这一问题，但仍受制于通信与计算操作之间的串行依赖。为应对该挑战，我们提出 ScMoE——一种新颖的捷径连接（shortcut-connected）MoE 架构，并配合重叠并行化策略。ScMoE 将通信与其传统的串行次序解耦，使其与计算的重叠最高可达 100%。与主流的 top-2 MoE 基线相比，ScMoE 在训练中取得 1.49× 加速、在推理中取得 1.82× 加速。此外，我们的实验与分析表明，ScMoE 不仅达到与现有方法相当的模型质量，在某些情形下甚至更优。

Keywords: Mixture of experts, Expert parallelism, Shortcut connection

关键词：混合专家、专家并行、捷径连接

1Introduction引言

In recent years, Transformer-based large language models (LLMs) have significantly propelled the fields of Natural Language Processing (Vaswani et al., 2017; Brown et al., 2020; Wei et al., 2022b; Ouyang et al., 2022; Wei et al., 2022a; Chowdhery et al., 2023; Achiam et al., 2023), Computer Vision (Dosovitskiy et al., 2021; Liu et al., 2021), and Multimodality (Lu et al., 2019; Zhou et al., 2022; Zhang et al., 2021; Zhu et al., 2023). The sparsely-gated mixture-of-experts (MoE) approach has been integral in increasing parameter counts and enhancing model performance across various modalities (Shazeer et al., 2017; Riquelme et al., 2021; Mustafa et al., 2022; Jiang et al., 2024). Expert parallelism (Lepikhin et al., 2021; Fedus et al., 2022) has emerged as a viable strategy to efficiently distribute MoE computations over multiple devices, synergizing with conventional parallelism techniques (Hwang et al., 2023; Singh et al., 2023) such as data parallelism (Rajbhandari et al., 2020; Rajbhandari et al., 2021) and model parallelism (Narayanan et al., 2021; Smith et al., 2022).

近年来，基于 Transformer 的大语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）显著推动了自然语言处理（Vaswani et al., 2017; Brown et al., 2020; Wei et al., 2022b; Ouyang et al., 2022; Wei et al., 2022a; Chowdhery et al., 2023; Achiam et al., 2023）、计算机视觉（Dosovitskiy et al., 2021; Liu et al., 2021）与多模态（Lu et al., 2019; Zhou et al., 2022; Zhang et al., 2021; Zhu et al., 2023）等领域的发展。稀疏门控混合专家（MoE）方法在提升参数量、增强各模态模型性能方面已成为不可或缺的一环（Shazeer et al., 2017; Riquelme et al., 2021; Mustafa et al., 2022; Jiang et al., 2024）。专家并行（Lepikhin et al., 2021; Fedus et al., 2022）已成为在多设备上高效分摊 MoE 计算的可行策略，并与数据并行（Rajbhandari et al., 2020; Rajbhandari et al., 2021）、模型并行（Narayanan et al., 2021; Smith et al., 2022）等传统并行技术协同发挥作用。

Nevertheless, expert parallelism incurs substantial All-to-All communication overhead (Lepikhin et al., 2021; Fedus et al., 2022), which can contribute to approximately 50% of the total time in intra-node multi-GPUs or multi-nodes distributed environments (see Figure 1), thus forming a critical bottleneck in scaling MoE models (Nie et al., 2022; Hwang et al., 2023; Mayer & Jacobsen, 2020; Smith et al., 2022). Despite existing optimizations such as hierarchical All-to-All (He et al., 2022; Nie et al., 2022) and pipelining (Hwang et al., 2023; Zhang et al., 2023) strategies that mitigate communication delays and partially overlap communication with computation, the communication challenge persists due to the inherent sequential dependencies between these operations (Wang et al., 2023). To address this constraint, our intuitive idea is to reconstruct the inputs of MoE layer by incorporating not only the current-layer but also the preceding-layer representations through a shortcut connection, thereby refining the communication-computation dependencies and expanding the potential for their overlapping optimization.

然而，专家并行会带来可观的 All-to-All 通信开销（Lepikhin et al., 2021; Fedus et al., 2022）。在节点内多 GPU 或跨节点的分布式环境中，这部分开销可占总时间的约 50%（见图 1），从而成为扩展 MoE 模型的关键瓶颈（Nie et al., 2022; Hwang et al., 2023; Mayer & Jacobsen, 2020; Smith et al., 2022）。尽管已有分层 All-to-All（He et al., 2022; Nie et al., 2022）与流水线（Hwang et al., 2023; Zhang et al., 2023）等优化策略可缓解通信延迟、使通信与计算部分重叠，但由于这些操作之间存在固有的串行依赖，通信难题依然存在（Wang et al., 2023）。为突破这一限制，我们的直观想法是：借助捷径连接，不仅引入当前层的表示、也引入前一层的表示来重构 MoE 层的输入，从而改善通信与计算之间的依赖关系，扩大二者重叠优化的空间。

In this paper, we propose the shortcut-connected MoE (ScMoE) architecture, which completely decouples communication processes from the sequence of conventional MoE models. ScMoE architecture is initially built on the standard top-2 MoE (see Figure 2 (a)), which typically substitutes the multi-layer perceptron (MLP) module with a top-2 gating MoE module in every second Transformer block (refer to the Transformer block with the MoE module as “current layer”, and the preceding one without the MoE module as “preceding layer”). Diverging from the top-2 approach, ScMoE utilizes a top-1 MoE module to process preceding-layer representations via a shortcut connection, while employing a shared expert (an MLP module) to process current-layer representations. These two processes are independently managed in parallel, with their results integrated into the final output of the current layer. Furthermore, the ScMoE architecture can be extended to accommodate MoE models that employ various MoE placement frequencies, such as integrating an MoE module into every Transformer block.

本文提出捷径连接的 MoE（ScMoE）架构，把通信过程与传统 MoE 模型的执行序列彻底解耦。ScMoE 架构最初建立在标准 top-2 MoE 之上（见图 2(a)）：后者通常每隔一个 Transformer block，就用 top-2 门控 MoE 模块替换多层感知机（MLP）模块（我们把含 MoE 模块的 Transformer block 称为“当前层”，把其之前不含 MoE 模块的那一层称为“前一层”）。与 top-2 方案不同，ScMoE 借助捷径连接，用 top-1 MoE 模块处理前一层的表示，同时用共享专家（一个 MLP 模块）处理当前层的表示。这两个过程各自独立、并行执行，结果汇入当前层的最终输出。此外，ScMoE 架构还可扩展，以适配采用不同 MoE 放置频率的 MoE 模型，例如在每个 Transformer block 中都插入 MoE 模块。

To efficiently overlap the decoupled communication and computation within the ScMoE architecture, we implement an adaptive overlapping parallel strategy that dynamically schedules operators based on actual performance metrics. Compared to existing optimization strategies such as pipelining (Huang et al., 2019; Hwang et al., 2023), our approach not only doubles the overlap duration, but also realizes complete overlapping of communication in scenarios where communication time does not exceed the computation duration. Furthermore, our method essentially advances the MoE architecture in algorithm aspect, which is device-agnostic to improve the efficiency of MoE model, thus ensuring a broad applicability across various hardware configurations and maintaining compatibility with current optimizations.

为在 ScMoE 架构内高效重叠解耦后的通信与计算，我们实现了一种自适应重叠并行策略，它根据实际性能指标动态调度算子。与流水线等现有优化策略（Huang et al., 2019; Hwang et al., 2023）相比，我们的方法不仅把重叠时长延长一倍，还能在通信时间不超过计算时长的场景下实现通信的完全重叠。此外，我们的方法在算法层面实质性地推进了 MoE 架构，且与设备无关，可提升 MoE 模型的效率，从而保证在多种硬件配置上的广泛适用性，并与现有优化保持兼容。

The experimental results reveal that, compared to the standard top-2 MoE, our proposed ScMoE architecture optimally accelerates training by 1.49× and 1.14× in 8×A30-PCIe and 8×A800-NVLink scenarios characterized by high and low communication overheads, respectively, and accelerates inference by 1.82× and 1.21×. Moreover, we perform experiments on different configurations of the ScMoE architecture, including shortcut-connected position and coefficient gating network. Considering the optimal accuracy and the relatively longer overlap duration, we favor selecting the intermediate representations between the Attention and MLP modules in the preceding layer as the input for the gate-routed experts. In addition, ScMoE has been demonstrated through experiments and theoretical analysis to attain or exceed the model quality of existing methods in both vision and language downstream tasks. We also conduct an in-depth analysis and discussion of the ScMoE architecture, investigating the proposed shortcut connection and exploring opportunities for further development.

实验结果显示，与标准 top-2 MoE 相比，在通信开销较高与较低的 8×A30-PCIe 和 8×A800-NVLink 场景中，我们提出的 ScMoE 架构分别把训练加速 1.49× 与 1.14×，把推理加速 1.82× 与 1.21×。此外，我们针对 ScMoE 架构的不同配置进行了实验，包括捷径连接的位置与系数门控网络。综合考虑最优精度与相对更长的重叠时长，我们倾向于选取前一层中 Attention 与 MLP 模块之间的中间表示，作为门控路由专家的输入。另外，实验与理论分析证明，ScMoE 在视觉与语言下游任务中达到或超过了现有方法的模型质量。我们还对 ScMoE 架构作了深入分析与讨论，考察了所提出的捷径连接，并探索了进一步发展的空间。

In summary, our contributions are as follows:

综上，我们的贡献如下：

  • We propose the shortcut-connected MoE (ScMoE) architecture that breaks the conventional dependency between communication and computation in distributed MoE models, bypassing the restrictions imposed on current communication optimization techniques.我们提出捷径连接的 MoE（ScMoE）架构，打破了分布式 MoE 模型中通信与计算之间的传统依赖，绕开了当前通信优化技术所受的限制。
  • We develop an adaptive overlapping strategy for advancing expert parallelism with the shortcut-connected MoE, which significantly improves the efficiency of MoE models and ensures broad compatibility.我们为结合捷径连接 MoE 的专家并行开发了一种自适应重叠策略，显著提升 MoE 模型的效率，并保证广泛的兼容性。
  • We conduct empirical evaluation and theoretical analysis on our methods, confirming that our methods accelerate MoE models while achieving comparable or even better model quality compared to existing methods, and offer in-depth analysis and discussion on the effectiveness of the proposed shortcut connection.我们对所提方法进行了实证评估与理论分析，确认其能在加速 MoE 模型的同时，取得与现有方法相当甚至更优的模型质量，并就所提捷径连接的有效性给出了深入分析与讨论。

2Background & Related Work背景与相关工作

2.1Sparsely-Gated Mixture of Experts稀疏门控混合专家

The sparsely-gated mixture-of-experts (Shazeer et al., 2017) (MoE) layer is composed of multiple multi-layer perceptron (MLP) sub-networks, termed “experts,” and employs a trainable gating network to selectively activate a subset of these experts during each iteration. Given N expert networks {Ei}1N, gating network G and input representation x, the output of MoE module can be written:

稀疏门控混合专家（Shazeer et al., 2017）（MoE）层由多个多层感知机（MLP）子网络组成，这些子网络称为“专家”，并由一个可训练的门控网络在每次迭代中选择性地激活其中一部分。给定 N 个专家网络 {Ei}1N、门控网络 G 与输入表示 x，MoE 模块的输出可写为：

MoE(x)=∑i=1NG(x)iEi(x).MoE(x)=\sum_{i=1}^{N}G(x)_{i}E_{i}(x).MoE(x)=i=1∑N​G(x)i​Ei​(x).(1)

Following the prevailing approach in existing MoE research, we use the noisy top-k softmax gating network to select k experts for the computation, formalized by

沿用现有 MoE 研究的主流做法，我们使用带噪声的 top-k softmax 门控网络为计算选择 k 个专家，形式化为

G(x)=Softmax(TopK‾(H(x),k)),G(x)=Softmax(\overline{TopK}(H(x),k)),G(x)=Softmax(TopK​(H(x),k)),(2)
TopK‾(H(x),k)i={H(x)i, if H(x)i∈TopK(H(x)).−∞, otherwise.\overline{TopK}(H(x),k)_{i}=\begin{cases}H(x)_{i},~\text{if $H(x)_{i}\in TopK(H(x))$.}\\ -\infty,~\text{otherwise.}\end{cases}TopK​(H(x),k)i​={H(x)i​, if H(x)i​∈TopK(H(x)).−∞, otherwise.​(3)
H(x)i=(x⋅Wgate)i+ϵi,H(x)_{i}=(x\cdot W_{gate})_{i}+\epsilon_{i},H(x)i​=(x⋅Wgate​)i​+ϵi​,(4)
ϵi=StandardNormal()⋅Softplus((x⋅Wnoise)i),\epsilon_{i}=StandardNormal()\cdot Softplus((x\cdot W_{noise})_{i}),ϵi​=StandardNormal()⋅Softplus((x⋅Wnoise​)i​),(5)

where ε is tunable Gaussian noise, Wgate and Wnoise denote two trainable weight matrices.

其中 ε 是可调的高斯噪声，Wgate 与 Wnoise 表示两个可训练的权重矩阵。

Leveraging sparse output of G(x), this approach significantly increases the number of model parameters without causing a proportional increase in computational demand. The value of k can be set to 1 or 2 or even higher values. Opting for a larger k moves the model closer to the dense architecture, which generally results in higher prediction accuracy (Riquelme et al., 2021), but also leads to greater computational overhead.

利用 G(x) 的稀疏输出，这一方法显著增加了模型参数量，却不会引起计算需求的成比例增长。k 的取值可设为 1 或 2，甚至更大。选择更大的 k 会让模型更接近稠密架构，通常带来更高的预测精度（Riquelme et al., 2021），但同时也会带来更大的计算开销。

Figure 2 (a) illustrates the prevailing top-2 MoE architecture. Each Transformer block with MoE module, denoted by a light blue block and referred to as “Block-MoE,” replaces the MLP with a set of experts (“E1, E2, E3, E4”) and a gating network (“Gate”). Following prior work (Lepikhin et al., 2021; Du et al., 2022; Shen et al., 2023; Hwang et al., 2023; Lieber et al., 2025), the “Block-MoE” is interspersed with the conventional Transformer block, depicted as a gray block and referred to as “Block-MLP.” Additionally, various options exist for the frequency of MoE module placement, including placing an MoE module into every block (Jiang et al., 2024; Dai et al., 2024; Qwen, 2024; Databricks, 2024) or every four blocks (Zoph et al., 2022; Xue et al., 2024).

图 2(a) 展示了主流的 top-2 MoE 架构。每个含 MoE 模块的 Transformer block（图中以浅蓝色块表示，称为“Block-MoE”）用一组专家（“E1、E2、E3、E4”）和一个门控网络（“Gate”）替代 MLP。沿用先前工作（Lepikhin et al., 2021; Du et al., 2022; Shen et al., 2023; Hwang et al., 2023; Lieber et al., 2025），“Block-MoE”与传统 Transformer block（图中灰色块，称为“Block-MLP”）交替出现。此外，MoE 模块的放置频率有多种选择，包括每个 block 都放一个 MoE 模块（Jiang et al., 2024; Dai et al., 2024; Qwen, 2024; Databricks, 2024），或每四个 block 放一个（Zoph et al., 2022; Xue et al., 2024）。

Shared Expert. In contrast to the standard top-2 MoE architecture, the shared-expert MoE incorporates a fixed dense MLP module to process all input tokens, combining its output with the result from the top-1 gating expert for each token, as illustrated in Figure 2 (b). Given the shared expert SE, the output of the MoE module is formulated as:

共享专家。与标准 top-2 MoE 架构不同，共享专家 MoE 引入一个固定的稠密 MLP 模块处理所有输入 token，并把其输出与每个 token 经 top-1 门控专家得到的结果合并，如图 2(b) 所示。给定共享专家 SE，MoE 模块的输出可表示为：

MoE(x)=SE(x)+∑i=1NG(x)iEi(x).MoE(x)=SE(x)+\sum_{i=1}^{N}G(x)_{i}E_{i}(x).MoE(x)=SE(x)+i=1∑N​G(x)i​Ei​(x).(6)

This method, originally proposed by DeepSpeed-MoE (Rajbhandari et al., 2022), activates the same number of experts as the standard MoE for computation while reducing dynamic expert selection and communication volume. Extensive empirical results from DeepSpeed-MoE and subsequent studies (Dai et al., 2024; Qwen, 2024) demonstrate that the shared expert architecture achieves model quality that is on par with or even superior to existing approaches, leading to its growing adoption (Xue et al., 2024; Wu et al., 2023; Chen et al., 2024; Gou et al., 2023; Gao et al., 2024).

该方法最初由 DeepSpeed-MoE（Rajbhandari et al., 2022）提出，其激活的专家数量与标准 MoE 相同，但减少了动态专家选择与通信量。DeepSpeed-MoE 及后续研究（Dai et al., 2024; Qwen, 2024）的大量实证结果表明，共享专家架构取得的模型质量与现有方法相当甚至更优，因而得到日益广泛的采用（Xue et al., 2024; Wu et al., 2023; Chen et al., 2024; Gou et al., 2023; Gao et al., 2024）。

2.2Expert Parallelism专家并行

To facilitate efficient distributed training and inference of MoE models, expert parallelism is proposed to allocate unique experts to each distributed computing device such as GPU and TPU, and map tokens to their corresponding experts through All-to-All communication across participating devices (Lepikhin et al., 2021; He et al., 2021; Nie et al., 2022). As illustrated in Figure 3, the workflow of MoE employing expert parallelism is segmented into the following sequential operations: gate routing, input encode, All-to-All dispatch, expert computation, All-to-All combine, and output decode. To enhance the efficiency, input encode is employed to aggregate the token data layout to a contiguous format before All-to-All dispatch, and output decode is the inverse process after All-to-All combine. Furthermore, the integration of expert parallelism with other parallelisms (Hwang et al., 2023; Singh et al., 2023; Fedus et al., 2022; Zheng et al., 2022) has been explored to support the scaling of larger MoE models on extensive distributed systems. However, the All-to-All communication used for token transfer has been a primary bottleneck limiting the efficiency of distributed MoE models, as shown in Figure 1.

为支持 MoE 模型的高效分布式训练与推理，专家并行被提出：把不同的专家分配到每台分布式计算设备（如 GPU、TPU）上，并通过参与设备间的 All-to-All 通信把 token 映射到对应的专家（Lepikhin et al., 2021; He et al., 2021; Nie et al., 2022）。如图 3 所示，采用专家并行的 MoE 工作流被划分为以下依次执行的操作：门控路由、输入编码、All-to-All 分发、专家计算、All-to-All 合并与输出解码。为提升效率，输入编码在 All-to-All 分发之前把 token 的数据布局聚合为连续格式，输出解码则是 All-to-All 合并之后的逆过程。此外，已有研究探索了专家并行与其他并行方式的结合（Hwang et al., 2023; Singh et al., 2023; Fedus et al., 2022; Zheng et al., 2022），以支持在大型分布式系统上扩展更大的 MoE 模型。然而，如图 1 所示，用于传输 token 的 All-to-All 通信一直是限制分布式 MoE 模型效率的主要瓶颈。

3Shortcut-connected MoE Designs捷径连接的 MoE 设计

In the prevailing Transformer-based model, the MoE module substitutes MLP to sequentially manipulate intermediate representations (Lepikhin et al., 2021; Du et al., 2022; Shen et al., 2023), impeding the efficacy of existing optimization strategies (He et al., 2022; Nie et al., 2022; Hwang et al., 2023; Zhang et al., 2023) due to the limited interaction within the MoE module. To address the aforementioned limitations, we propose the shortcut-connected MoE (ScMoE) architecture, which enables optimization opportunities for computation-communication overlap for expert parallelism.

在目前主流的基于 Transformer 的模型中，MoE 模块替代 MLP、以串行方式处理中间表示（Lepikhin et al., 2021; Du et al., 2022; Shen et al., 2023）；由于 MoE 模块内部的交互有限，这妨碍了现有优化策略（He et al., 2022; Nie et al., 2022; Hwang et al., 2023; Zhang et al., 2023）发挥效力。为解决上述局限，我们提出捷径连接的 MoE（ScMoE）架构，为专家并行的计算—通信重叠创造优化机会。

3.1Architectural Design架构设计

In this section, we introduce the shortcut-connected MoE (ScMoE) architecture. Unlike the prevailing MoE architectures, illustrated in Figure 2, which focus on processing intermediate representations within the current layer (the Transformer block containing the MoE), the ScMoE processes representations from both the current and preceding layers. Specifically, ScMoE employs a top-1 MoE module to handle representations from the preceding layer via a shortcut connection, while a shared expert processes the current-layer representations. These two operations are conducted independently, with their outcomes integrated into the final output of the current layer, facilitating communication and computation overlap between these two processes.

本节介绍捷径连接的 MoE（ScMoE）架构。图 2 所示的主流 MoE 架构专注于处理当前层（即包含 MoE 的 Transformer block）内的中间表示；与之不同，ScMoE 同时处理当前层与前一层这两层的表示。具体而言，ScMoE 用一个 top-1 MoE 模块通过捷径连接处理前一层的表示，同时由共享专家处理当前层的表示。这两个操作独立执行，其结果合并为当前层的最终输出，从而使两个过程之间的通信与计算得以重叠。

While the shared expert processes the same intermediate representations in the current layer as the prevailing MoE approaches, we explore three distinct preceding-layer representations for ScMoE’s top-1 MoE process, as illustrated in Figure 4. The configurations “Pos-1” (a), “Pos-2” (b), and “Pos-3” (c) represent shortcuts connecting different positions of the preceding layer: output, intermediate, and input, respectively. Given that 𝒯Atten, 𝒯SE, and 𝒯MLP represent the durations of Attention, Shared Expert, and MLP, respectively, the corresponding overlap durations are (a) 𝒯Atten+𝒯SE, (b) 𝒯Atten+𝒯SE+𝒯MLP, (c) 2𝒯Atten+𝒯SE+𝒯MLP.

共享专家所处理的当前层中间表示与主流 MoE 方法相同；在此基础上，我们为 ScMoE 的 top-1 MoE 过程探索了三种不同的前一层表示，如图 4 所示。“Pos-1”（a）、“Pos-2”（b）与“Pos-3”（c）三种配置分别表示捷径连接接在前一层的不同位置：输出、中间表示与输入。设 𝒯Atten、𝒯SE 与 𝒯MLP 分别表示 Attention、共享专家与 MLP 的耗时，则相应的重叠时长为：（a）𝒯Atten+𝒯SE，（b）𝒯Atten+𝒯SE+𝒯MLP，（c）2𝒯Atten+𝒯SE+𝒯MLP。

Using the “Pos-2” configuration as an example, this ScMoE architecture can be formulated as follows:

以“Pos-2”配置为例，该 ScMoE 架构可形式化如下：

Block-MoE:

Hl+1ScMoE=Hl+1MH+SE(l+1)(Hl+1MH)+∑i=1NG(HlMH)iEi(HlMH),\mathcal{H}_{l+1}^{\text{ScMoE}} =\mathcal{H}^{MH}_{l+1}+SE^{(l+1)}(\mathcal{H}^{MH}_{l+1}) +\sum_{i=1}^{N}G(\mathcal{H}^{MH}_{l})_{i}E_{i}(\mathcal{H}^{MH}_{l}),Hl+1ScMoE​=Hl+1MH​+SE(l+1)(Hl+1MH​)+i=1∑N​G(HlMH​)i​Ei​(HlMH​),(7)

Block-MLP:

where ℋl+1ScMoE refers to the output from the MoE sub-layer, ℋl+1MH signifies the output from the Multi-Head Attention (MultiHead) sub-layer MultiHead(l+1)MoE(·) in the (l+1)-th Transformer block (“Block-MoE”). SE(l+1)(·) denotes the shared expert while E1,...,EN represent the N gate-routed experts. The gating network G(·) is referred to as Equation 2. ℋlMLP and ℋlMH are the outputs of the MLP sub-layer MLP(l)(·) and the MultiHead sub-layer MultiHead(l)MLP(·), respectively, in the l-th Transformer block (“Block-MLP”). Note that we omit the pre-layer normalization and dropout for simplicity.

其中 ℋl+1ScMoE 表示 MoE 子层的输出，ℋl+1MH 表示第 (l+1) 个 Transformer block（“Block-MoE”）中多头注意力（MultiHead）子层 MultiHead(l+1)MoE(·) 的输出。SE(l+1)(·) 表示共享专家，E1,...,EN 表示 N 个经门控路由的专家。门控网络 G(·) 见公式 2。ℋlMLP 与 ℋlMH 分别是第 l 个 Transformer block（“Block-MLP”）中 MLP 子层 MLP(l)(·) 与 MultiHead 子层 MultiHead(l)MLP(·) 的输出。注意，为简明起见我们省略了层前归一化与 dropout。

In our experiments involving three shortcut-connected positions, models configured with “Pos-2” achieve the highest accuracy in both vision and language cases, while also ensuring substantial overlap duration. As a result, we favor selecting “Pos-2” for practical development. Moreover ,the “Pos-2” configuration is used to elucidate the overlapping strategy in Section 3.2. The specifics of the other two configurations can be inferred by analogy.

在我们涉及三种捷径连接位置的实验中，“Pos-2”配置在视觉与语言两类任务上都取得了最高精度，同时保证了可观的重叠时长。因此，我们在实际开发中倾向于选用“Pos-2”。此外，第 3.2 节以“Pos-2”配置来阐述重叠策略，另外两种配置的具体做法可类推。

Additionally, our proposed ScMoE architecture can be adapted to support MoE models with varying MoE placement frequencies. As illustrated in Figure 5, the ScMoE architecture can be integrated into MoE models that incorporate an MoE module into every Transformer block. With more frequent MoE placement, the potential overlap duration for each MoE module is minimized, and the “Pos-1” configuration has already fully utilized the computation duration for the overlap. Conversely, less frequent MoE placement extends the potential overlap duration for each MoE module, which may lead to increased acceleration.

此外，我们提出的 ScMoE 架构还可适配 MoE 放置频率各异的 MoE 模型。如图 5 所示，ScMoE 架构可以集成到每个 Transformer block 都含 MoE 模块的 MoE 模型中。MoE 放置越频繁，每个 MoE 模块的潜在重叠时长越短，而“Pos-1”配置已能充分利用计算时长完成重叠。反之，MoE 放置越稀疏，每个 MoE 模块的潜在重叠时长越长，可能带来更高的加速。

3.2Overlapping Strategy for Expert Parallelism面向专家并行的重叠策略

As mentioned in the previous section, the MoE operations in ScMoE architecture are completely decoupled from the backbone network, enabling parallel execution across two independent streams: one for the shared expert process and the other for the MoE process. To enhance efficiency, we implement asynchronous All-to-All communication operators to enable the overlapping of communication and computation within these streams, while computation operators are unable to execute concurrently due to the constraints on computing resources.

如上一节所述，ScMoE 架构中的 MoE 操作与主干网络完全解耦，因而可在两条独立的数据流上并行执行：一条用于共享专家过程，另一条用于 MoE 过程。为提升效率，我们实现了异步 All-to-All 通信算子，使这些数据流内部的通信与计算得以重叠；而计算算子因受计算资源限制，无法并发执行。

Adaptive Operators Scheduling. We observe that operator execution times are influenced by the specific model and hardware configuration, necessitating the implementation of adaptive scheduling for operators.

自适应算子调度。我们观察到算子执行时间受具体模型与硬件配置影响，因此需要对算子实施自适应调度。

Following the execution order in the MoE stream, we can directly schedule the gate routing and encode operators at the earliest viable position while deferring the decode operator to the latest position, thereby maximizing the potential duration for overlapping. Then, this challenge is distilled into the selection of an optimal position for expert computation among four possible locations ①②③④ within the shared expert stream, as depicted in Figure 6.

按照 MoE 数据流中的执行顺序，我们可以把门控路由与编码算子直接调度到最早可行的位置，而把解码算子推迟到最晚位置，从而最大化可用于重叠的潜在时长。于是，问题归结为：在共享专家数据流的四个候选位置 ①②③④ 中，为专家计算选择一个最优位置，如图 6 所示。

Formally, we define the communication costs associated with “All-to-All Dispatch” and “All-to-All Combine” as 𝒯disp and 𝒯comb, respectively. The variable 𝒦 is designated to represent the specific location where expert computation is applied. Prior to the expert computation, the computational costs are denoted as 𝒯compprecoloneqq{COMP1,...,COMP𝒦-1}, while the costs following the expert computation are represented as 𝒯comppostcoloneqq{COMP𝒦+1,...,COMP4}. Consequently, the minimal aggregate time cost for each pair consisting of one Block-MLP and one Block-MoE is

形式化地，我们把“All-to-All 分发”与“All-to-All 合并”的通信开销分别记为 𝒯disp 与 𝒯comb。变量 𝒦 表示专家计算所放置的具体位置。在专家计算之前，计算开销记为 𝒯comppre := {COMP1,...,COMP𝒦-1}；专家计算之后的开销记为 𝒯comppost := {COMP𝒦+1,...,COMP4}。因此，对每一对“一个 Block-MLP + 一个 Block-MoE”，最小总时间开销为

Toverallblock=min⁡K(∣Tcomppre−Tdisp∣+∣Tcomppost−Tcomb∣)=min⁡K(∣∑i=1K−1COMPi−Tdisp∣+∣ ⁣ ⁣∑i=K+14 ⁣ ⁣ ⁣COMPi−Tcomb∣),\mathcal{T}_{overall}^{block} =\min_{\mathcal{K}}(|\mathcal{T}_{comp}^{pre}-\mathcal{T}_{disp}|+|\mathcal{T}_{comp}^{post}-\mathcal{T}_{comb}|) =\min_{\mathcal{K}}(|\sum_{i=1}^{\mathcal{K}-1} COMP_{i}-\mathcal{T}_{disp}|+|\!\!\sum_{i=\mathcal{K}+1}^{4}\!\!\!COMP_{i}-\mathcal{T}_{comb}|),Toverallblock​=Kmin​(∣Tcomppre​−Tdisp​∣+∣Tcomppost​−Tcomb​∣)=Kmin​(∣i=1∑K−1​COMPi​−Tdisp​∣+∣i=K+1∑4​COMPi​−Tcomb​∣),(11)
Toverallblock≥∣(Tcomppre+Tcomppost)−(Tdisp+Tcomb)∣,\mathcal{T}_{overall}^{block}\geq|(\mathcal{T}_{comp}^{pre}+\mathcal{T}_{comp}^{post})-(\mathcal{T}_{disp}+\mathcal{T}_{comb})|,Toverallblock​≥∣(Tcomppre​+Tcomppost​)−(Tdisp​+Tcomb​)∣,(12)
Toverallblock≤(Tcomppre+Tcomppost)+(Tdisp+Tcomb).\mathcal{T}_{overall}^{block}\leq(\mathcal{T}_{comp}^{pre}+\mathcal{T}_{comp}^{post})+(\mathcal{T}_{disp}+\mathcal{T}_{comb}).Toverallblock​≤(Tcomppre​+Tcomppost​)+(Tdisp​+Tcomb​).(13)

To demonstrate the efficiency, we have illustrated the operational timelines of various MoE architectures alongside their respective parallel strategies in Figure 7, exemplified by the selection of location ② for expert computation. Each timeline’s operator length corresponds to its execution time, and the presence of multiple rows signifies the utilization of parallel CUDA streams.

为展示其效率，我们在图 7 中给出了多种 MoE 架构及其对应并行策略的运行时间线，示例中专家计算选择位置 ②。每条时间线中算子的长度对应该算子的执行时间，出现多行表示使用了并行的 CUDA stream。

The widely-used pipeline parallel strategy equally segments input tokens into smaller fine-grained chunks, enabling concurrent computation and communication dispatched on distinct GPU streams (Hwang et al., 2023; Zhang et al., 2023). Contrary to standard MoE with pipelining (2nd timeline), our proposed ScMoE with the overlapping strategy (4th timeline) significantly reduces the total time. This reduction is attributed to the decrease in absolute communication time, similar to that in the shared-expert MoE (3rd timeline), and the overlap of communication with the computation duration (𝒯Atten+𝒯SE+𝒯MLP), which extends beyond the overlap duration achieved through pipelining.

广泛使用的流水线并行策略把输入 token 等分成更小的细粒度 chunk，使计算与通信可在不同的 GPU stream 上并发执行（Hwang et al., 2023; Zhang et al., 2023）。与采用流水线的标准 MoE（第 2 条时间线）相反，我们提出的 ScMoE 配合重叠策略（第 4 条时间线）显著缩短了总时间。这一缩减来自两方面：一是绝对通信时间的减少（与共享专家 MoE 即第 3 条时间线类似），二是通信与计算时长（𝒯Atten+𝒯SE+𝒯MLP）的重叠，而该重叠时长超出了流水线所能达到的重叠时长。

Our strategy possesses the capability to fully overlap communication if the communication can be accommodated within the overlapping window. This advantage is not shared by the pipeline strategy as it cannot overlap the initial and terminal data transmissions (Huang et al., 2019; Narayanan et al., 2019). In cases where communication durations exceed the available overlap duration, our strategy can be augmented with pipelining (5th timeline), thus utilizing the expert computation duration to further hide communication.

若通信能够容纳在重叠窗口之内，我们的策略可以完全重叠通信。流水线策略不具备这一优势，因为它无法重叠最初与最后一段数据传输（Huang et al., 2019; Narayanan et al., 2019）。当通信时长超出可用的重叠时长时，我们的策略可与流水线叠加使用（第 5 条时间线），从而利用专家计算时长进一步隐藏通信。

4Experiments实验

4.1Experimental Setup实验设置

To assess the effectiveness of our proposed overlapping strategy for enhancing expert parallelism, we conduct experiments on three hardware configurations: 8×A30-PCIe, 8×A800-NVLink, and 16×A800-NVLink (across 2 nodes). These configurations cover scenarios with both high and low communication-to-computation ratios. Furthermore, we evaluated our methods using both vision models (SwinV2-MoE) (Hwang et al., 2023) and language models (GPT2-MoE, GPT3-MoE, LLaMA2-MoE) (Radford et al., 2019; Brown et al., 2020; Touvron et al., 2023). Additional details on the experimental setup are provided in Appendix A.8.

为评估所提出的重叠策略对增强专家并行的效果，我们在三种硬件配置上开展实验：8×A30-PCIe、8×A800-NVLink 与 16×A800-NVLink（跨 2 个节点）。这些配置覆盖了通信与计算之比较高和较低的两类场景。此外，我们用视觉模型（SwinV2-MoE）（Hwang et al., 2023）与语言模型（GPT2-MoE、GPT3-MoE、LLaMA2-MoE）（Radford et al., 2019; Brown et al., 2020; Touvron et al., 2023）评估了所提方法。实验设置的更多细节见附录 A.8。

4.2Analysis of Model Quality and Efficiency模型质量与效率分析

In this section, we assess the quality of the models with our proposed ScMoE architecture. Furthermore, we evaluate the efficiency of ScMoE models in distributed scenarios, which are accelerated through our proposed overlapping strategy for enhancing expert parallelism. To maintain the same computational volume as the standard top-2 MoE, both the experimental shared-expert MoE and our ScMoE utilize one shared expert and one gate-routed expert.

本节评估采用我们提出的 ScMoE 架构的模型质量。此外，我们评估 ScMoE 模型在分布式场景下的效率——这些模型借助我们提出的、用于增强专家并行的重叠策略获得加速。为保持与标准 top-2 MoE 相同的计算量，实验中的共享专家 MoE 与我们的 ScMoE 均使用一个共享专家和一个经门控路由的专家。

4.2.1Vision Model视觉模型

Table 1 shows that ScMoE (Pos-2) and the standard top-2 MoE attain a comparable accuracy of 79.3%, while the shared-expert MoE delivers the highest accuracy, with a marginal increase of 0.2%. In 8×A30-PCIe where communication overhead accounts for 60% of the total MoE time, ScMoE (Pos-2) exhibits 30% speed improvement in training and 40% in inference compared to the standard top-2 MoE.

表 1 显示，ScMoE（Pos-2）与标准 top-2 MoE 的精度相当，均为 79.3%；共享专家 MoE 的精度最高，微增 0.2%。在通信开销占 MoE 总时间 60% 的 8×A30-PCIe 上，与标准 top-2 MoE 相比，ScMoE（Pos-2）的训练速度提升 30%、推理速度提升 40%。

In scenarios characterized by a high communication-to-computation ratio, where communication is hard to be completely overlapped by computation, ScMoE architectures with extended overlap durations can achieve superior speedup. Specifically, ScMoE (Pos-3), which has the longest overlap duration of 𝒯Atten+𝒯SE+𝒯MLP, achieves the highest acceleration, with a 1.49× speedup in training and a 1.82× speedup in inference. Furthermore, the three different ScMoE architectures result in minimal variations in accuracy, ranging from 79.14% to 79.38%. Additionally, these methods, which utilize two activated experts, consistently outperform the standard top-1 MoE in terms of model quality, as the top-1 approach activates fewer parameters.

在通信与计算之比较高、通信难以被计算完全重叠的场景中，重叠时长更长的 ScMoE 架构能取得更优的加速。具体而言，重叠时长最长（𝒯Atten+𝒯SE+𝒯MLP）的 ScMoE（Pos-3）加速最高，训练加速 1.49×、推理加速 1.82×。此外，三种不同的 ScMoE 架构在精度上差异极小，介于 79.14% 与 79.38% 之间。同时，这些激活两个专家的方法在模型质量上始终优于标准 top-1 MoE，因为 top-1 方案激活的参数更少。

4.2.2Language Model语言模型

To demonstrate the effectiveness of our proposed ScMoE architecture in models with two prevailing MoE placement frequency designs, we perform experiments using the GPT2-MoE-Medium and LLaMA2-MoE models, positioning the MoE module in every second Transformer block for GPT2-MoE and in every Transformer block for LLaMA2-MoE. Specifically, we utilize the ScMoE architecture with the configuration of “Pos-2” on the GPT2-MoE model, since this setup yields the lowest final validation loss in our experiments across various shortcut-connected positions, as discussed in Section 5.2. Furthermore, the ScMoE in LLaMA2-MoE adopts the “Pos-1” configuration, as this setup has already maximized the potential overlap duration in the scenario of MoE placement in every block.

为验证所提出的 ScMoE 架构在两种主流 MoE 放置频率设计下的有效性，我们使用 GPT2-MoE-Medium 与 LLaMA2-MoE 模型进行实验：GPT2-MoE 每隔一个 Transformer block 放置 MoE 模块，LLaMA2-MoE 则在每个 Transformer block 中放置。具体而言，我们在 GPT2-MoE 上采用“Pos-2”配置的 ScMoE 架构，因为在我们针对多种捷径连接位置的实验中，该设置取得了最低的最终验证损失，详见第 5.2 节。此外，LLaMA2-MoE 中的 ScMoE 采用“Pos-1”配置，因为在该 MoE 放置于每个 block 的场景下，此设置已使潜在重叠时长最大化。

As shown in Table 2, our ScMoE models achieve the highest average scores, with 38.69 in GPT2-MoE and 38.96 in LLaMA2-MoE. Furthermore, when integrated with our ScMoE, GPT2-MoE experienced an 11% improvement in training speed and an 15% improvement in inference speed compared to the standard top-2 MoE, in the 8×A800-NVLink scenario where communication accounts for 15% of the total MoE time. In LLaMA2-MoE, our ScMoE accelerated training by 1.14× and inference by 1.21×, demonstrating superior efficiency compared to other methods.

如表 2 所示，我们的 ScMoE 模型取得最高平均分：GPT2-MoE 上为 38.69，LLaMA2-MoE 上为 38.96。此外，在通信占 MoE 总时间 15% 的 8×A800-NVLink 场景中，集成 ScMoE 后，GPT2-MoE 的训练速度相比标准 top-2 MoE 提升 11%、推理速度提升 15%。在 LLaMA2-MoE 上，我们的 ScMoE 使训练加速 1.14×、推理加速 1.21×，效率优于其他方法。

4.2.3Analysis of Overhead and Acceleration开销与加速分析

In addition to exhibiting the end-to-end speedup of ScMoE in Tables 1 and 2, we delve into a detailed analysis of the overhead and the acceleration effect with our overlapping strategy, which can be generalized to other MoE models.

除在表 1 与表 2 中给出 ScMoE 的端到端加速外，我们进一步详细分析了重叠策略带来的开销与加速效果，该分析可推广到其他 MoE 模型。

In the communication-intensive 8×A30-PCIe scenario (Figure 8(a)), our ScMoE overlaps 70% communication time, resulting in a 27% speed improvement over shared-expert MoE, a 42% improvement over the pipelined standard top-2 MoE, and a 15% improvement over the pipelined standard top-1 MoE. In the 8×A800-NVLink scenario (Figure 8(b)), which features almost minimal communication overhead, our approach maintains its acceleration by fully overlapping.

在通信密集的 8×A30-PCIe 场景（图 8(a)）中，我们的 ScMoE 重叠了 70% 的通信时间，从而比共享专家 MoE 提速 27%、比采用流水线的标准 top-2 MoE 提速 42%、比采用流水线的标准 top-1 MoE 提速 15%。在通信开销几乎最低的 8×A800-NVLink 场景（图 8(b)）中，我们的方法通过完全重叠保持了加速效果。

In multi-node scenario (Figure 8(c)), with 16×A800-NVLink across two nodes, communication incurs more significant overhead than in the single-node 8×A800-NVLink scenario due to the lower-bandwidth inter-node Ethernet (Li et al., 2020). Here, our ScMoE achieves complete overlap, resulting in a 24% speed improvement over the shared-expert MoE, a 43% improvement over the pipelined standard top-2.

在多节点场景（图 8(c)，即跨两个节点的 16×A800-NVLink）中，由于节点间以太网（Li et al., 2020）带宽较低，通信开销比单节点 8×A800-NVLink 场景更为显著。此时我们的 ScMoE 实现了完全重叠，比共享专家 MoE 提速 24%、比采用流水线的标准 top-2 提速 43%。

In general, our ScMoE delivers a significant acceleration over the standard top-2 MoE, and even outperforms the top-1 MoE when communication exceeds approximately 20% of the total MoE time. Additionally, our ScMoE can fully overlap communication in scenarios where communication does not exceed an estimated 50% of the total MoE time.

总体而言，我们的 ScMoE 相对标准 top-2 MoE 带来显著加速；当通信超过 MoE 总时间的约 20% 时，甚至优于 top-1 MoE。此外，在通信不超过 MoE 总时间约 50% 的场景中，我们的 ScMoE 可以完全重叠通信。

5Discussion讨论

The empirical results presented in Section 4.2 have demonstrated that our proposed ScMoE architecture facilitates efficiency optimizations without compromising model quality. Subsequently, we delve into a more thorough examination of the proposed shortcut connection, uncovering potential underlying reasons for its algorithmic effectiveness, and identifying opportunities for further development.

第 4.2 节的实证结果表明，我们提出的 ScMoE 架构在不牺牲模型质量的前提下实现了效率优化。接下来，我们更深入地考察所提出的捷径连接，揭示其算法有效性的可能内在原因，并找出进一步发展的机会。

5.1Delve into the Proposed Shortcut Connection深入考察所提出的捷径连接

5.1.1Analysis of Gating Behaviors门控行为分析

Firstly, we investigate the use of the same MoE module to select the top-1 expert twice for processing each input token’s current-layer and preceding-layer representations, respectively. As illustrated in Figure 9(a), we observe that the same gating network typically selects the same expert for the two representations of most tokens. As the training progresses, the token percentage of repeating selection initially escalates, peaking at 98%, and then diminishes, with a significant drop manifested in the last MoE sub-layer.

首先，我们考察用同一个 MoE 模块为每个输入 token 的当前层与前一层的表示分别各选择一次 top-1 专家的做法。如图 9(a) 所示，我们观察到：对大多数 token，同一个门控网络为其两个表示选中的是同一个专家。随着训练推进，重复选择的 token 百分比先上升、峰值达 98%，随后下降，并在最后一个 MoE 子层出现显著跌落。

Next, we measure the L2 distance (similarity) between each token’s preceding-layer and current-layer representations. Figure 9(b) illustrates that, as training advances, the L2 distance initially decreases with network depth, then increases, and ultimately reaches its maximum value in the final layer. Since the gating network is used to classify the representations, this similarity may lead to the repeated selection of the same experts, as evidenced by the correlation between the results in Figure 9(a) and 9(b).

接着，我们测量每个 token 前一层与当前层表示之间的 L2 距离（相似度）。图 9(b) 显示，随着训练推进，L2 距离先随网络深度递减，然后增大，并在最后一层达到最大值。由于门控网络用于对表示进行分类，这种相似性可能导致重复选中同一专家——图 9(a) 与 9(b) 结果之间的相关性即为佐证。

Furthermore, we trained an experimental MoE model incorporating specialized MoE modules that select the top-1 expert twice for processing each input token’s current-layer and preceding-layer representations. We observe that this experimental architecture achieves a model quality equivalent to the standard top-1 MoE, despite incurring the same computational cost as the top-2 MoE. Interestingly, this architecture can achieve model quality comparable to the standard top-2 MoE by imposing a constraint on the MoE module that ensures the selection of a different expert for the current layer than for the preceding layer. We refer to this enhanced experimental architecture as DoubleGating MoE (DGMoE), with further details provided in Appendix A.2. With this constraint, we observe gating score behaviors are similar to those of the standard top-2 MoE (Riquelme et al., 2021), as illustrated in Figure 9(c) and 9(d).

进一步地，我们训练了一个实验性 MoE 模型，其中设有专门的 MoE 模块，为每个输入 token 的当前层与前一层的表示分别各选择一次 top-1 专家。我们观察到，该实验架构的模型质量仅相当于标准 top-1 MoE，尽管其计算开销与 top-2 MoE 相同。有意思的是，若对 MoE 模块施加约束——当前层与前一层的专家必须不同——该架构就能取得与标准 top-2 MoE 相当的模型质量。我们把这一增强后的实验架构称为 DoubleGating MoE（DGMoE），更多细节见附录 A.2。施加该约束后，我们观察到门控分数的表现与标准 top-2 MoE（Riquelme et al., 2021）类似，如图 9(c) 与 9(d) 所示。

5.1.2Analysis of Similarity in Representations表示相似性分析

Based on the observations mentioned above, we believe that the similarity between each token’s preceding-layer and current-layer representations is crucial to understanding these outcomes and validating the effectiveness of our proposed ScMoE model. Assuming that the representations of the preceding layer and the current layer are identical, utilizing the same expert to process these two representations is equivalent to employing a single expert to process only the current-layer representations, thereby resulting in model quality comparable to that of the standard top-1 MoE. On the other hand, assigning distinct experts to the two representations of each token is equivalent to activating two experts to process the current-layer representations, thereby achieving model quality similar to that of the standard top-2.

基于上述观察，我们认为每个 token 前一层与当前层表示之间的相似性，是理解这些结果、验证所提 ScMoE 模型有效性的关键。假设前一层与当前层的表示完全相同，那么用同一个专家处理这两个表示，等价于只用单个专家处理当前层表示，从而得到与标准 top-1 MoE 相当的模型质量。反之，为每个 token 的两个表示分配不同的专家，等价于激活两个专家来处理当前层表示，从而取得与标准 top-2 相近的模型质量。

Moreover, we analyze the similarities in the intermediate representations of the Swin-MoE-Small and GPT2-MoE-Medium models, which use the standard top-2 MoE, as illustrated in Figure 10(a) and 10(b). It is evident that the representations from adjacent Transformer blocks exhibit a cosine similarity close to 1.0, highlighting their high degree of similarity. Consequently, our proposed ScMoE architecture assigns distinct experts to the two representations of each token (a shared expert for current-layer representations and routed experts for preceding-layer representations), thereby preserving behavior akin to the standard top-2 and shared-expert MoE architectures and ensuring comparable model quality. Similar observations in LLaMA2-MoE and OLMoE (Muennighoff et al., 2024), as demonstrated in Appendix A.9, further confirm the generalizability of our ScMoE to other models.

此外，我们分析了采用标准 top-2 MoE 的 Swin-MoE-Small 与 GPT2-MoE-Medium 模型中间表示的相似性，如图 10(a) 与 10(b) 所示。可以看到，相邻 Transformer block 的表示余弦相似度接近 1.0，说明其高度相似。因此，我们提出的 ScMoE 架构为每个 token 的两个表示分配不同专家（当前层表示用共享专家，前一层表示用经路由的专家），从而保留与标准 top-2、共享专家 MoE 架构类似的行为，确保模型质量相当。如附录 A.9 所示，在 LLaMA2-MoE 与 OLMoE（Muennighoff et al., 2024）上的类似观察进一步证实了 ScMoE 对其他模型的泛化能力。

In addition, we provide a theoretical analysis of our proposed ScMoE architecture in Appendix A.1, elucidating the propagation of gradients to guarantee consistent training and preserve model quality.

此外，我们在附录 A.1 中对所提出的 ScMoE 架构给出了理论分析，阐明梯度传播过程，以保证训练的一致性并维持模型质量。

Coefficient Gating Network. In contrast to the gate-routed expert, the shared expert is fixed to process all representations without computing a gating score through the gating network. Therefore, some work (Qwen, 2024; Rajbhandari et al., 2022) employs a coefficient gating network CG to generate the coefficient for combining the outputs of gate-routed and shared experts. Specifically, the coefficient gating network is a linear layer that uses the MoE module’s input representation as its input to generate the coefficient.

We conduct experiments on ScMoE using three distinct methods for combining the outputs of gate-routed experts and shared experts: (1) Direct Add, (2) CG-1, and (3) CG-2. Moreover, ScMoE models with three configurations consistently outperform both the standard top-2 and the shared-expert MoE (configured with CG-2 according to (Rajbhandari et al., 2022)).

如表 3 所示，在三种合并方式（均设为 Pos-2）中，CG-1 配置取得最低的最终验证损失。此外，三种配置的 ScMoE 模型都始终优于标准 top-2 MoE 与共享专家 MoE（后者按（Rajbhandari et al., 2022）采用 CG-2 配置）。

Shortcut-connected Position. While the Pos-1 configuration can maximize the potential overlap duration when MoE is placed in every block, using different configurations of shortcut-connected positions (Pos-1, Pos-2 or Pos-3) when placing MoE in every second block will result in variations in overlap duration and model quality. Therefore, we conduct experiments to identify its optimal configuration.

捷径连接位置。当 MoE 放置于每个 block 时，Pos-1 配置可使潜在重叠时长最大化；但在每隔一个 block 放置 MoE 时，采用不同的捷径连接位置配置（Pos-1、Pos-2 或 Pos-3）会带来重叠时长与模型质量的差异。因此，我们通过实验确定其最优配置。

As shown in Table 3, ScMoE (Pos-2) achieves the lowest final validation loss among the configurations tested, all of which utilize the CG-1 setup. This outcome mirrors the findings from the vision experiments detailed in Table 1, where Pos-2 also delivers the highest accuracy.

如表 3 所示，在测试的配置（均采用 CG-1 设置）中，ScMoE（Pos-2）取得最低的最终验证损失。这一结果与表 1 中视觉实验的发现一致——那里 Pos-2 同样给出最高精度。

As illustrated in Figure 10(b), the input and intermediate representations of the first layer differ significantly from those of subsequent layers, with the MLP/MoE altering the representations more substantially than Attention. Therefore, we explore modifying the first MoE module to utilize Pos-1 while the remaining modules employ Pos-2, a configuration referred to as Pos-2 (L0 Pos-1). This setup results in a slightly higher loss compared to Pos-2 alone. Observations of varying shortcut-connected positions reveal that the superior performance of Pos-2 suggests the model quality of ScMoE is not necessarily improved by connecting more similar or dissimilar intermediate representations.

如图 10(b) 所示，第一层的输入与中间表示同后续各层差异显著，且 MLP/MoE 对表示的改变比 Attention 更大。因此，我们尝试把第一个 MoE 模块改为 Pos-1、其余模块仍用 Pos-2，该配置记为 Pos-2（L0 Pos-1）。相比单独使用 Pos-2，这一设置的损失略高。对不同捷径连接位置的观察表明，Pos-2 的优越性能说明：ScMoE 的模型质量并不必然因连接更相似或更不相似的中间表示而提升。

5.3Optimization for Memory-Limited Inference面向显存受限推理的优化

Existing studies (Hwang et al., 2024; Yi et al., 2023) offload expert parameters to CPU memory in memory-limited inference scenarios where GPU cannot store the full MoE model. These studies utilize information in preceding layers to predict expert selection for the current MoE layer, enabling early expert migration from CPU to GPU and overlapping it with model computation. In contrast to existing speculative expert migration methods, we implement an expert offloading strategy with overlapping determinate migration, built upon our ScMoE that inherently advances expert selection to the preceding layer. The experimental results demonstrate that our expert offloading strategy reduces peak GPU memory usage by up to 60% and decreases expert migration costs by up to 75% through overlapping with computation. More details are shown in Appendix A.3.

在 GPU 无法容纳完整 MoE 模型的显存受限推理场景中，已有研究（Hwang et al., 2024; Yi et al., 2023）把专家参数卸载到 CPU 内存。这些研究利用前一层的信息预测当前 MoE 层的专家选择，从而提前把专家从 CPU 迁移到 GPU，并与模型计算重叠。与现有的推测式专家迁移方法不同，我们实现了一种带重叠确定性迁移的专家卸载策略，它建立在 ScMoE 之上——后者天然把专家选择提前到前一层。实验结果表明，借助与计算重叠，我们的专家卸载策略使 GPU 峰值显存占用最多降低 60%，专家迁移开销最多减少 75%。更多细节见附录 A.3。

6Conclusion结论

The inherent dependency between communication and computation in conventional distributed MoE models hinders parallel optimization techniques to improve execution efficiency. To address this, we propose a shortcut-connected MoE (ScMoE) architecture, and develop a communication overlapping parallel strategy. Through empirical evaluation and theoretical analysis, our approaches demonstrate better execution efficiency while maintaining or exceeding the model quality of existing methods. In addition, we provide an insightful analysis and discussion of ScMoE.

传统分布式 MoE 模型中通信与计算之间的固有依赖，妨碍了并行优化技术提升执行效率。为此，我们提出捷径连接的 MoE（ScMoE）架构，并开发了通信重叠并行策略。通过实证评估与理论分析，我们的方法在保持或超越现有方法模型质量的同时，展现出更好的执行效率。此外，我们还对 ScMoE 作了有见地的分析与讨论。

Building upon Equations 7 to 10, and contrasting with ScMoE, DGMoE can be formulated as

为更深入地研究我们带捷径连接的架构，我们引入 DoubleGating MoE（DGMoE）架构：它采用双重 top-1 门控机制，分别独立处理来自前一层与当前层的表示，如图 11 所示。基于公式 7 至 10，并与 ScMoE 对照，DGMoE 可形式化为

Hl+1DGMoE=Hl+1MH+∑i=1N(G(Hl+1MH)iEi(Hl+1MH)+G(HlMH)iEi(HlMH)),\mathcal{H}_{l+1}^{\text{DGMoE}} =\mathcal{H}^{MH}_{l+1}+\sum_{i=1}^{N}(G(\mathcal{H}^{MH}_{l+1})_{i}E_{i}(\mathcal{H}^{MH}_{l+1}) +G(\mathcal{H}^{MH}_{l})_{i}E_{i}(\mathcal{H}^{MH}_{l})),Hl+1DGMoE​=Hl+1MH​+i=1∑N​(G(Hl+1MH​)i​Ei​(Hl+1MH​)+G(HlMH​)i​Ei​(HlMH​)),(23)

where ℋl+1DGMoE refers to the output from the MoE module.

其中 ℋl+1DGMoE 表示 MoE 模块的输出。

However, as delineated in Equation 23, a potential issue arises when a token at the current layer selects the same top-1 expert as the preceding layer, inadvertently collapsing the intended top-2 gating mechanism into a de facto top-1 gating mechanism. To mitigate this, we introduce a constraint that ensures the activation of two distinct experts. In practice, this is achieved by first documenting the indices of experts triggered by the preceding-layer representations. Subsequently, if the preceding-layer representation coincidentally targets the same expert as the current layer, that is, if TopK(H(ℋMHl),1)=TopK(H(ℋMHl+1),1), we activate the second-highest-ranking expert from the top-2 selection for the current layer, i.e., TopK(H(ℋMHl+1),2)2.

然而，如公式 23 所示，当当前层的某个 token 选中了与前一层相同的 top-1 专家时，会出现一个潜在问题：本应是 top-2 的门控机制被无意间退化为事实上的 top-1。为缓解这一问题，我们引入一个约束，确保激活两个不同的专家。实践中，先记录前一层表示所触发的专家索引；随后，若前一层表示恰好指向与当前层相同的专家，即 TopK(H(ℋMHl),1)=TopK(H(ℋMHl+1),1)，我们为当前层激活 top-2 候选中排名第二的专家，即 TopK(H(ℋMHl+1),2)2。

As illustrated in Table 6 and Table 7, our DGMoE achieves comparable accuracy to the standard top-2 MoE across both vision and language tasks. Meanwhile, our ScMoE demonstrates performance more akin to the shared-expert MoE.

如表 6 与表 7 所示，我们的 DGMoE 在视觉与语言任务上都取得了与标准 top-2 MoE 相当的精度。同时，我们的 ScMoE 表现更接近共享专家 MoE。

A.3 Shortcut-connected MoE for Optimizing Memory-Limited InferenceA.3 用捷径连接 MoE 优化显存受限推理

While MoE effectively enhances LLMs in terms of model quality, it faces significant deployment challenges during on-device inference due to high memory demand. A common approach is to offload expert parameters to CPU memory (Shen et al., 2022) in scenarios where GPU memory is insufficient to store the entire MoE model. Moreover, decoder-only models use an autoregressive process for natural language generation (NLG) inference tasks, allowing for per-token processing of MoE. Specifically, only the two activated experts (top-2 gating) for each token need to be transferred from CPU to GPU memory for computation, thereby reducing peak GPU memory usage.

MoE 虽能有效提升 LLM 的模型质量，但因显存需求高，在端侧推理部署时面临显著挑战。一种常见做法是：当 GPU 显存不足以容纳整个 MoE 模型时，把专家参数卸载到 CPU 内存（Shen et al., 2022）。此外，decoder-only 模型在自然语言生成（Natural Language Generation, NLG）推理任务中采用自回归过程，允许按 token 逐个处理 MoE。具体而言，每个 token 只需把被激活的两个专家（top-2 门控）从 CPU 迁移到 GPU 显存参与计算，从而降低峰值显存占用。

Since the migration of activated expert parameters from CPU to GPU, which occurs after expert selection, blocks expert computation until the transfer is complete, existing studies (Hwang et al., 2024; Yi et al., 2023; Du et al., 2024) have explored prefetching the experts. For instance, Pre-gated MoE (Hwang et al., 2024) uses information from preceding layers to predict expert selection, allowing for preloading of expert parameters into GPU memory, as shown in Figure 12 (a). This method enables overlapping the expert migration duration with the computation of preceding modules. Moreover, speculative expert migration methods adjust only the expert selection process, while expert computation continues along the same data flow of representations as in standard MoE.

由于被激活的专家参数是在专家选择之后才从 CPU 迁移到 GPU，这一迁移在完成之前会阻塞专家计算，因此已有研究（Hwang et al., 2024; Yi et al., 2023; Du et al., 2024）探索了专家预取。例如 Pre-gated MoE（Hwang et al., 2024）利用前一层的信息预测专家选择，从而把专家参数预加载进 GPU 显存，如图 12(a) 所示。该方法使专家迁移时长可与前序模块的计算重叠。此外，推测式专家迁移方法只调整专家选择过程，专家计算仍沿标准 MoE 的表示数据流进行。

However, speculative expert migrations can suffer from estimation inaccuracies, as they deviate from the original logic of pre-trained models, potentially reducing inference accuracy. In contrast, our proposed ScMoE architecture utilizes the gate-routed expert to compute the preceding-layer representations, inherently facilitating early expert migration well before the expert computation in the current layer. This allows us to implement an expert offloading strategy with overlapping determinate migration, maintaining the pre-trained logic.

然而，推测式专家迁移可能因估计不准而受损——它们偏离了预训练模型的原有逻辑，可能降低推理精度。相比之下，我们提出的 ScMoE 架构用门控路由的专家来计算前一层的表示，天然地把专家迁移提前到当前层专家计算之前很久。这使我们能够实现一种带重叠确定性迁移的专家卸载策略，同时保持预训练的逻辑。

Additionally, existing expert migration methods cannot be adapted to overlap communication in expert parallelism. This is because they do not decouple dependencies in the data flow of expert processing representations, and therefore cannot adjust the All-to-All communication of these representations

此外，现有专家迁移方法无法用于重叠专家并行中的通信。原因是它们没有解耦“专家处理表示”这一数据流中的依赖关系，因而无法调整这些表示的 All-to-All 通信

A.3.1 Expert Offloading StrategyA.3.1 专家卸载策略

We implement an expert offloading strategy that keeps non-expert and shared expert modules in GPU memory while offloading other gate-routed experts to CPU memory. After the Attention module in the preceding layer generates intermediate representations, the gate determines expert selection and issues asynchronous migration of the activated expert, as illustrated in Figure 12(b). This approach allows expert migration to overlap with the computation duration. Importantly, expert selection in our method adheres to the logic of the pre-trained ScMoE model, without speculation.

我们实现的专家卸载策略把非专家模块与共享专家模块保留在 GPU 显存中，而把其余门控路由的专家卸载到 CPU 内存。前一层中的 Attention 模块产生中间表示后，门控即确定专家选择，并发起被激活专家的异步迁移，如图 12(b) 所示。该方法使专家迁移可与计算时长重叠。重要的是，我们方法中的专家选择遵循预训练 ScMoE 模型的逻辑，不含推测。

A.3.2 EvaluationA.3.2 评测

We evaluate our proposed expert offloading strategy on models with our ScMoE (Pos-2) architecture, using a platform with a single A30-PCIe GPU. As demonstrated in Figure 13(a), our expert offloading strategy reduces peak GPU memory usage by 50% for the GPT2-MoE-Medium model and by 60% for the GPT3-MoE-XL model when deployed in the inference scenario using a single A30-PCIe GPU. Furthermore, it is anticipated that models with more gate-routed experts in each MoE module will experience a larger percentage reduction in GPU memory usage.

我们在配备单张 A30-PCIe GPU 的平台上，用采用 ScMoE（Pos-2）架构的模型评估所提出的专家卸载策略。如图 13(a) 所示，在单张 A30-PCIe GPU 的推理部署场景下，我们的专家卸载策略使 GPT2-MoE-Medium 的峰值显存占用降低 50%、GPT3-MoE-XL 降低 60%。此外，可以预期：每个 MoE 模块中门控路由专家越多的模型，其显存占用的下降比例越大。

Since the offloaded expert parameters must be loaded into the GPU memory for expert computation, the blocking execution of this expert migration results in significant overhead. As shown in Figure 13(b), the blocking expert migration introduces an additional overhead of 80% in GPT2-MoE-Medium and 240% in GPT3-MoE-XL, substantially increasing the MoE block latency. To mitigate this issue, our strategy of asynchronously executing the determinate expert migration effectively reduces the additional costs by 75% in GPT2-MoE-Medium and 25% in GPT3-MoE-XL.

由于被卸载的专家参数必须载入 GPU 显存才能参与专家计算，这种阻塞式迁移带来显著开销。如图 13(b) 所示，阻塞式专家迁移在 GPT2-MoE-Medium 上引入 80% 的额外开销、在 GPT3-MoE-XL 上引入 240% 的额外开销，大幅增加 MoE block 延迟。为缓解该问题，我们异步执行确定性专家迁移的策略，使额外开销在 GPT2-MoE-Medium 上有效降低 75%、在 GPT3-MoE-XL 上降低 25%。

Furthermore, it is evident that expanding the model size from Medium to XL significantly raises the cost proportion related to expert migration. This is because the per-token decoding process during inference is memory-bound (Patel et al., 2024; Wu et al., 2024). The larger model size leads to a proportional increase in the duration of memory transfer, without a corresponding increase in computation time.

此外，模型规模从 Medium 扩展到 XL 后，与专家迁移相关的开销占比明显上升。这是因为推理时逐 token 的解码过程受显存带宽限制（memory-bound）（Patel et al., 2024; Wu et al., 2024）：模型越大，显存传输时长成比例增加，而计算时间并未相应增加。

A.4 Analysis of More Activated ExpertsA.4 更多激活专家的分析

As increasing the number of activated experts within standard MoE is correlated with enhancements in model quality, we implement this augmentation in our ScMoE by increasing the count of gate-routed experts that process the preceding-layer representations, while maintaining the process of current-layer representations. To investigate the benefits of more activated experts, we implement the ScMoE-2, which employs top-2 experts for the preceding layer and one shared expert for the current layer.

由于在标准 MoE 中增加激活专家数与模型质量提升相关，我们在 ScMoE 中做同样的增强：增加处理前一层表示的门控路由专家数量，同时保持当前层表示的处理方式不变。为考察更多激活专家带来的收益，我们实现了 ScMoE-2：对前一层采用 top-2 专家，对当前层使用一个共享专家。

Comparative analyses with the standard top-3 MoE, which has the same computational volumes as our ScMoE-2, reveal that our ScMoE architectures maintain superiority in both model quality and efficiency, as evidenced in Table 4. Furthermore, akin to the standard MoE, our ScMoE consistently improves with additional expert activation, shown by a decrease in validation perplexity from 16.46 with ScMoE to 16.27 with ScMoE-2.

与计算量相同的标准 top-3 MoE 对比分析表明，我们的 ScMoE 架构在模型质量与效率两方面均保持优势，见表 4。此外，与标准 MoE 类似，我们的 ScMoE 随激活专家增多而持续改善：验证困惑度从 ScMoE 的 16.46 降至 ScMoE-2 的 16.27。

Although activating more experts incurs higher time costs, the efficiency improvements of our overlapping strategy remain significant. For instance, our ScMoE-2 requires merely 95% and 93% of the time cost necessary for the standard top-2 MoE respectively in training and inference, despite processing increased computational loads.

尽管激活更多专家带来更高的时间开销，我们重叠策略的效率提升依然显著。例如，尽管计算负载增加，ScMoE-2 在训练与推理中所需的时间开销分别仅为标准 top-2 MoE 的 95% 与 93%。

A.5 Coefficient Gating Network in Vision TaskA.5 视觉任务中的系数门控网络

As shown in Table 5, the incorporation of the coefficient gating network significantly enhances model performance in our experimental vision tasks. In the absence of the coefficient gating network, the quality of MoE architectures with shared experts declines from that of a standard top-2 MoE to that of a standard top-1 MoE, despite maintaining the same computational volume as the standard top-2 MoE.

如表 5 所示，在我们的视觉实验中，引入系数门控网络显著提升了模型性能。若不使用系数门控网络，带共享专家的 MoE 架构质量会从标准 top-2 MoE 的水平下降到标准 top-1 MoE 的水平，尽管其计算量与标准 top-2 MoE 相同。

A.6 Evaluation Across Different Model SizesA.6 不同模型规模上的评测

Table 6 and Table 7 illustrate that our experimental MoE architectures consistently achieve analogous model quality across different model sizes, as expounded in the detailed analysis within the main body of this paper.

表 6 与表 7 表明，我们的实验性 MoE 架构在不同模型规模上都能稳定取得相近的模型质量，本文正文已对此作了详细分析。

A.7 Share MoE Across Multiple Layers via Shortcut ConnectionsA.7 通过捷径连接在多层间共享 MoE

From a certain point of view, our shortcut-connected MoE architectures can be conceptualized as the sharing of one MoE module across multiple transformer layers. Parameter sharing across different layers has been validated as a method to enhance parameter efficiency and improve model quality, as evidenced in existing research (Lan et al., 2019; Dehghani et al., 2018; Xue et al., 2022; Huang et al., 2017).

从某种角度看，我们的捷径连接 MoE 架构可以理解为把一个 MoE 模块共享给多个 transformer 层。跨层参数共享已被验证为提升参数效率、改善模型质量的方法，现有研究（Lan et al., 2019; Dehghani et al., 2018; Xue et al., 2022; Huang et al., 2017）即为佐证。

The empirical analysis of our novel MoE architectures suggests that the MoE modules shared across multiple layers via shortcuts could offer a more parameter-efficient solution. We conduct experiments on a preliminary architecture DGMoE-Share which shares a single MoE for two pairs of transformer blocks. It reduces the parameter count from 157M to 124M, while maintaining the same volume of expert computation as the standard top-1 MoE. The DGMoE-Share achieves a 78.45% accuracy on the vision task, incurring a minimal accuracy decrement of 0.5% relative to the standard top-1 MoE. We anticipate the discovery of more efficient architectures through future explorations. Additionally, the optimization of training hyperparameters for the shortcut-connected MoE requires more investigation.

对这一新型 MoE 架构的实证分析表明，通过捷径在多层间共享 MoE 模块，可能提供更省参数的方案。我们在一个初步架构 DGMoE-Share 上做了实验：它为两对 transformer block 共享同一个 MoE。参数量从 157M（1.57 亿）降到 124M（1.24 亿），同时保持与标准 top-1 MoE 相同的专家计算量。DGMoE-Share 在视觉任务上取得 78.45% 的精度，相对标准 top-1 MoE 仅下降 0.5%。我们期待通过后续探索发现更高效的架构。此外，捷径连接 MoE 的训练超参数优化仍需更多研究。

A.8 Experimental DetailsA.8 实验细节

Hardware Configurations. To assess the effectiveness of our proposed overlapping strategy for enhancing expert parallelism, we conducted experiments on three hardware configurations: 8×A30-PCIe, 8×A800-NVLink and 16×A800-NVLink (across 2 nodes). These configurations cover scenarios with both high and low communication-to-computation ratios. Additionally, we evaluate our proposed expert offloading strategy on a configuration with a single A30-PCIe GPU.

硬件配置。为评估所提出的重叠策略对增强专家并行的效果，我们在三种硬件配置上开展实验：8×A30-PCIe、8×A800-NVLink 与 16×A800-NVLink（跨 2 个节点）。这些配置覆盖了通信与计算之比较高和较低的场景。此外，我们在单张 A30-PCIe GPU 的配置上评估了所提出的专家卸载策略。

Experiments on Vision Model. To evaluate the efficacy of our MoE architectures on vision tasks, we conduct experiments on SwinV2-MoE model, which is a state-of-the-art vision transformer model built upon the Tutel MoE framework (Hwang et al., 2023; Liu et al., 2021). Specifically, we pre-train the SwinV2-MoE models with various MoE architectures on ImageNet-1K image classification dataset, and subsequently evaluate their accuracy on the corresponding test set. It is noteworthy that the integration of the MoE module within SwinV2 is confined to stages 3 and 4, with our architectural enhancements being selectively applied to the MoE modules in stage 3—the deepest submodel. Given our hardware constraints, we configure each MoE module with 8 experts, assigning one expert per GPU device. Table 9 summarizes the hyperparameters for training the Swin-MoE models including SwinV2-MoE-S and SwinV2-MoE-B. Specifically, the experiments related to overhead and acceleration analysis in a 2-node (16×A800-NVLink) scenario utilize 16 experts per MoE module, while other cases use 8 experts. To maintain the comparability of our experiments, we limit our modifications solely to the MoE architectures and keep the hyperparameters and random seeds consistent. In addition, the experimental results related to efficiency are the averages of multiple samples over different periods.

视觉模型实验。为评估我们的 MoE 架构在视觉任务上的效果，我们在 SwinV2-MoE 模型上开展实验——这是一个构建于 Tutel MoE 框架之上的先进视觉 transformer 模型（Hwang et al., 2023; Liu et al., 2021）。具体而言，我们在 ImageNet-1K 图像分类数据集上预训练采用不同 MoE 架构的 SwinV2-MoE 模型，随后在对应测试集上评测精度。值得注意的是，SwinV2 中 MoE 模块的集成仅限于第 3、4 阶段，我们的架构改进只选择性地施加于第 3 阶段的 MoE 模块——即最深的子模型。受硬件条件限制，我们把每个 MoE 模块配置为 8 个专家，每张 GPU 分配一个专家。表 9 汇总了训练 Swin-MoE 模型（含 SwinV2-MoE-S 与 SwinV2-MoE-B）的超参数。具体而言，2 节点（16×A800-NVLink）场景下与开销、加速分析相关的实验使用每个 MoE 模块 16 个专家，其他情形使用 8 个专家。为保证实验可比性，我们只改动 MoE 架构，超参数与随机种子保持一致。此外，与效率相关的实验结果是对不同时段多次采样取平均得到的。

Experiments on Language Model. For natural language generation (NLG) tasks, we utilize the standard implementations of GPT-2 (Radford et al., 2019), GPT-3 (Brown et al., 2020) and LLaMA-2 (Touvron et al., 2023) from Fairseq (Ott et al., 2019), augmented with Tutel MoE to construct GPT2-MoE, GPT3-MoE and LLaMA2-MoE models. Specifically, we implement GPT2-MoE and GPT3-MoE by substituting the MLP with MoE in the second Transformer block of every consecutive pair, while implement LLaMA2-MoE by by substituting the MLP with MoE in every Transformer block. For models undergoing zero-shot evaluation on downstream tasks such as HellaSwag (Zellers et al., 2019), PIQA (Bisk et al., 2020), WinoGrande (Sakaguchi et al., 2021), BoolQ (Clark et al., 2019), ARC-Easy (Clark et al., 2018), OpenBookQA (Mihaylov et al., 2018), RACE (Lai et al., 2017), and MathQA (Amini et al., 2019), we pre-train the models using various architectures on a 1B token subset of the SlimPajama-627B dataset (Soboleva et al., 2023). For models evaluated on WikiText-103 (Merity et al., 2017), we conduct pre-training with different architectures on the OpenWebtext dataset (Gokaslan & Cohen, 2019). Table 8 summarizes the hyperparameters for training the GPT2-MoE-Small, GPT2-MoE-Medium, GPT3-MoE-XL and LLaMA-MoE models.

语言模型实验。对于自然语言生成（NLG）任务，我们采用 Fairseq（Ott et al., 2019）中 GPT-2（Radford et al., 2019）、GPT-3（Brown et al., 2020）与 LLaMA-2（Touvron et al., 2023）的标准实现，并配合 Tutel MoE 构建 GPT2-MoE、GPT3-MoE 与 LLaMA2-MoE 模型。具体而言，GPT2-MoE 与 GPT3-MoE 是在每相邻两个 Transformer block 的第二个 block 中用 MoE 替换 MLP；LLaMA2-MoE 则是在每个 Transformer block 中都用 MoE 替换 MLP。对于在下游任务（HellaSwag（Zellers et al., 2019）、PIQA（Bisk et al., 2020）、WinoGrande（Sakaguchi et al., 2021）、BoolQ（Clark et al., 2019）、ARC-Easy（Clark et al., 2018）、OpenBookQA（Mihaylov et al., 2018）、RACE（Lai et al., 2017）与 MathQA（Amini et al., 2019））上做零样本评测的模型，我们在 SlimPajama-627B 数据集（Soboleva et al., 2023）的 10 亿 token 子集上，用不同架构进行预训练。对于在 WikiText-103（Merity et al., 2017）上评测的模型，我们则在 OpenWebtext 数据集（Gokaslan & Cohen, 2019）上以不同架构进行预训练。表 8 汇总了训练 GPT2-MoE-Small、GPT2-MoE-Medium、GPT3-MoE-XL 与 LLaMA-MoE 模型的超参数。
